editorial.blurb: This Hyde Park gem brings together pristine sushi and Italian classics with warm, attentive service and genuinely creative rolls that keep locals coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Sit at the sushi bar to watch the chefs work their magic—and don't skip the signature rolls like Chicago Fire, Super Crunchy, or Feisty Flamingo; ask for extra mango mayo or jalapeño mayo on the side.
